core_obligations: [d](x+y) = [d](x) + [d](y); translations are automorphisms, so the etale locus of [d] is translation-invariant, hence empty or all of A (flagged 'some details omitted' is the orbit one-liner).
[d] is finite locally free (registered S7 degree lemma); etale at e is equivalent to injectivity of d[d] on the tangent space (cited Varieties and Morphisms lemmas).
The registered addition-tangent-vectors lemma (S7 card) gives d[d] = multiplication by d on T_{A/k, e}.
Conclude: etale everywhere iff etale at e iff d != 0 in k (nonzero A needed for the converse).
proof_roadmap: translation-invariance reduction + registered finite-locally-free + cited tangent dictionary + registered d[d] computation.
difficulty_reason: Compact complete assembly: homomorphism identity plus translation automorphisms make the etale locus translation-invariant (residual 'some details omitted' = the orbit one-liner); finite locally free (registered S7 lemma) plus the cited tangent-space dictionary reduces etaleness at e to injectivity of d[d]; the registered addition-tangent-vectors lemma computes d[d] as multiplication by d.
